# 0172. Goldens are generated by CI and updated by failed id

## Status

Accepted.

## Context

Goldens must be captured where they are compared (the pinned image, the hosted
runners), and an update must not rewrite images that did not change.

## Decision

- `just goldens-gui RUN_ID update` captures in CI and uploads
  `cosmyx-gui-goldens-<os>` (images and report); it never fails.
- `just goldens-gui-fetch RUN_ID` downloads them and rewrites only the goldens
  that failed, adds the new ones and removes the ones the pass no longer
  produced; passed ones are never touched.
- `just goldens-gui-review` writes a before/after page of every changed golden
  (HEAD against the working tree) to look at before committing; the same view
  goes in the pull request.
- The first golden set is generated this way on the final head of the T16
  branch and committed in the same pull request.

## Consequences

- No golden is ever produced on a developer machine with the host's own
  display.
